data.reason_zh: 提出可证伪世界模型，由异常与实验反馈生成并验证规则，且跨任务复用，符合方法型持续自改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Unexpected outcomes and decision-relevant unknowns trigger hypothesis formation.
scope_support.object_quote: EvoBelief, a self-evolving world model that represents environment knowledge as falsifiable hypotheses.
scope_support.persistence_quote: Across four benchmarks spanning static dynamics, hidden drift, and scientific discovery, EvoBelief improves task performance and reuses learned rules across tasks.
